description: Implementation of VideoFrameRateEstimator class for estimating video frame rate based on frame timestamps, including initialization, updating, and discontinuity handling.

classes.name: VideoFrameRateEstimator
classes.description: Class responsible for estimating and refining the video frame rate based on frame timestamps.

methods.name: VideoFrameRateEstimator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the frame rate estimator.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the frame rate estimate with a new set of frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the frame rate estimate to an invalid state.

methods.name: CalculateInitialFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the initial frame rate from a set of frames, optionally using a previous frame duration.

methods.name: RefineFrameRate
methods.description: Refines the current frame rate estimate based on new frame timestamps.
